## D — Light, weather and driving emergencies
Accuracy scope: Light, weather and driving emergencies; each fact block identifies exactly one registered physical source page.
Conventional-brake and ABS instructions are distinguished. Numerical lighting and following examples retain their conditions. No personal safety clearance or universal vehicle stopping performance is inferred. Older vehicle-specific steering-lock sequences, uncertain wiper-delay advice and the sharply worded shoulder-return step remain debt.
The author completed a semantic source-fidelity pass over every drafted fact before submission; the scratch receipts enumerate every fact identifier and verdict. This is same-model work and independent coverage and hallucination review remain pending.
Shared pages contribute noncommercial material only. Unreadable graphics are withheld; no picture-dependent rule has been reconstructed from memory.
Currency warning: applicability of the issuer-linked older edition remains source debt (verify WY-SEC13-FRESH).

corpus_stability.reason: Single issuer-linked edition is staged; this is an operational corpus classification, not a verified update frequency or present legal currency. The current issuer warning is retained as source freshness debt in A and D.

verification_debt.claim_text: The issuer warns printed manual material can be outdated; refresh before asserting present-day legal applicability.

Physical page 77 describes increasing following distance at least three or four seconds without clearly distinguishing a total interval from an added interval. No exact new following-time threshold is inferred.
The specialized composite-beam passage on physical page 78 lacks vehicle-specific application; no high-beam retaliation or adjustment procedure is taught.
Physical page 79 recommends a short delay before using wipers after rain begins; no delay is taught where visibility could be impaired, pending current official support.
Physical page 82 characterizes pumping or releasing pressure as turning off ABS; the mechanical claim is withheld while its steady-pressure instruction is retained.

The brake-failure pumping instruction on physical page 82 does not clearly specify the braking system or failure mode. Vehicle-specific verification is required before teaching it as a universal response.

The ignition-lock operating table on physical page 83 is credited to a much older vehicle-system reference and does not establish applicability to a particular vehicle; system-specific steps are withheld.

Physical page 83 says to turn sharply back onto pavement after slowing and checking traffic. That steering instruction is withheld pending current official support rather than generalized as a safe recovery maneuver.
